# pve_ceph_status (Data Source)

Ceph cluster status (cluster-wide and per-node alias) plus the service metadata inventory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_status" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `scope` (String) Which metadata facet to return: 'all' enriches the per-daemon metadata with the PVE-side service state (presence of unit, data directory), 'versions' collects only per-node Ceph binary version data. (default: all) One of: `all`, `versions`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `node_status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_status))
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `mds` (Attributes) Metadata servers configured in the cluster and their properties, keyed by '<name>@<host>'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--mds))
- `mgr` (Attributes) Managers configured in the cluster and their properties, keyed by '<name>@<host>'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--mgr))
- `mon` (Attributes) Monitors configured in the cluster and their properties, keyed by '<name>@<host>'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--mon))
- `node` (Attributes) Ceph version installed on the nodes, keyed by node name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--node))
- `osd` (Attributes List) OSDs configured in the cluster and their properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--osd))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata--osd"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.osd`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (Number) OSD ID.
- `back_addr` (String) Bind addresses and ports for backend inter OSD traffic.
- `ceph_release` (String) Ceph release codename currently used.
- `ceph_version` (String) Version info currently used by the service.
- `ceph_version_short` (String) Short version (numerical) info currently used by the service.
- `device_ids` (String) Comma-joined list of device identifiers (e.g. 'sdb=<serial>,sdc=<serial>').
- `device_paths` (String) Comma-joined list of /dev/disk/by-path entries for the underlying devices.
- `devices` (String) Comma-joined list of underlying device names (e.g. 'sdb,sdc').
- `front_addr` (String) Bind addresses and ports for frontend traffic to OSDs.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname on which the service is running.
- `mem_swap_kb` (Number) Memory of the service currently in swap.
- `mem_total_kb` (Number) Memory consumption of the service.
- `osd_data` (String) Path to the OSD data directory.
- `osd_objectstore` (String) OSD objectstore type.
